title: Probabilistic Classification System reference solution and reviewer guide
solution_outline: Start with the project objective: Develop a classifier whose probability outputs are evaluated and calibrated appropriately.
Audit rows, types, missing data, target/feature definitions, and potential leakage before fitting.
Create a baseline, use a split and metrics appropriate to the task, then compare candidates in a reproducible workflow.
Keep all learned preprocessing and feature selection inside the pipeline/cross-validation workflow where appropriate.
Inspect representative errors, record random seeds and versions, and document the limits of the experiment.
review_notes: A small automatic keyword check is not proof of correctness; inspect code, evidence, evaluation design, and failure cases.
completion_standard: A reviewer can recreate the environment, run the workflow locally, reproduce the reported checks, inspect the saved results, and understand limitations without access to secrets or production data.
